today.desc: Unofficial Python implementation of DTCP-IP with DLNA/UPnP support
features: - Asynchronous Python library (DLNAClient, DTCPClient, DubbingReceiver): DTCP-IP reception can be integrated into any Python application through Pydantic models and type-safe events

- Streaming reception without consuming the copy count: Data delivery with backpressure control through asynchronous callbacks, and transfer to FFplay or similar tools through standard output (stream)
- Diagnostic data export: Export of protocol responses from unsupported models with identifying information and program titles masked for issue reports (dump --mask-private)
today.trDesc: 具有 DLNA/UPnP 支持的非官方 DTCP-IP Python 实现
today.trFeat:
- 异步 Python 库（DLNAClient、DTCPClient、DubbingReceiver）：通过 Pydantic 模型和类型安全事件，可将 DTCP-IP 接收集成到任何 Python 应用程序中
- 不消耗拷贝次数的流式接收：通过异步回调进行带背压控制的数据传输，并通过标准输出（流）传输到 FFplay 或类似工具 - 诊断数据导出：从不支持的型号导出协议响应，其中用于问题报告的识别信息和程序标题被屏蔽（dump --mask-private）

today.desc: a fast, customizable macOS space switcher
features: - Private macOS behaviour. The trackpad data, the synthetic swipe, the list of spaces and one of the screen captures are not public API. A macOS update can break any of them. It is developed and tested on macOS 27 only.
- No Mac App Store, no notarized download. That is why it is built from source.
- A short screen freeze at launch. macOS only draws the active space, so Interspace visits each space once behind a frozen picture to capture it. It takes about a second.
- A new desktop shows your wallpaper the first time you swipe to it. Use Capture All Spaces Again in the menu to avoid that.
- Mission Control. A swipe while Mission Control is open is not handled well.
- macOS asks again for Screen Recording from time to time. That is system policy for every app that captures the screen.
today.trDesc: 一款快速、可定制的 macOS 空间切换器
today.trFeat:
- 私有 macOS 行为。触控板数据、合成滑动、桌面列表和其中一张屏幕截图均不属于公共 API。macOS 更新可能会破坏其中任何一项。它仅在 macOS 27 上开发和测试。
- 没有 Mac App Store，没有经过公证的下载。这就是为什么它要从源代码构建。
- 启动时屏幕短暂冻结。 macOS 仅绘制活动空间，因此 Interspace 会在冻结的图片后面访问每个空间一次，以便进行捕获。这大约需要一秒钟的时间。
- 当您第一次滑动到新桌面时，该桌面会显示您的壁纸。请在菜单中使用“再次捕获所有桌面”以避免这种情况。
- Mission Control。在 Mission Control 打开时进行滑动操作无法得到妥善处理。
- macOS 会不时再次请求屏幕录制权限。 这是针对所有截屏应用的系统策略。

today.desc: macOS app that links Claude Code conversations on a graph so context flows between them
features: - Add conversations — drag them from the sidebar, or right-click empty canvas → Add Conversation Here.
- Link them — drag the ⊕ on a card onto another card (or right-drag from a card). Drag back the other way for ⇄. Click an arrow to re-attach either end, flip it, or remove it.
- Peek — hover an arrow to see exactly what will flow next (or what went in last).
- Preview — the inspector of a receiving conversation shows the exact text its next message will carry.

- Keep working — double-click a card to continue that conversation (claude --resume) in the terminal on the right. Tabs, splits (⌘D) and a vertical tab list are built in, and terminals keep running when you quit the app.
- Workspaces — keep separate graphs and terminal layouts (⌘1…9). The same conversation can sit in several workspaces, and arrows cross workspaces.
- From inside Claude Code — type /ctx (the app installs this skill): /ctx from <name pulls another conversation's context in, /ctx to <name sends this one's out, /ctx link <name shares both ways.
today.trDesc: 一款 macOS 应用程序，可在图表上关联 Claude Code 对话，以便在它们之间传递上下文
today.trFeat:
- 添加对话：从侧边栏拖动对话，或右键单击空白画布 → 在此处添加对话。
- 将它们关联起来——将一张卡片上的 ⊕ 拖拽到另一张卡片上（或从一张卡片上右键拖拽）。向相反方向拖动以获得⇄。点击箭头，即可重新连接任一端、翻转箭头或将其移除。
- 预览 — 将鼠标悬停在箭头上，即可确切查看接下来将流向什么（或最后流向了什么）。 - 预览 — 接收对话的检查器显示下一条消息将包含的确切文本。
- 继续工作 — 双击卡片，在右侧的终端中继续该对话 (claude --resume)。内置选项卡、拆分 (⌘D) 和垂直选项卡列表，退出应用程序时终端仍将继续运行。
- 工作区 — 保持独立的图表和终端布局 (⌘1…9)。 同一段对话可以存在于多个工作区中，箭头则跨越工作区。
- 在 Claude Code 中 — 输入 /ctx（该应用程序会安装此技能）： /ctx from <name 将另一个对话的上下文拉入，/ctx to <name 将此对话的上下文送出，/ctx link <name 实现双向共享。

week.desc: A live map beside the chat that shows what Claude Code is doing: tool calls, model steps, hooks, skills and subagents light up as they happen. Local only, in 7 languages.
features: - a file: the last two parts of its path;
- a web address: the host alone, without a login, password, path or query; an address that can be read two ways shows only its scheme;
- a shell command: the short description Claude wrote for it, or the command's name, never the command line. The description is the model's own words, and the mod shows them as written;
- a memory call: the tool's name and a record number or short identifier, never the text or the query;
- a memory command: its name, and the word after it only if you listed that word in memorySubcommands;
- a subagent: the short description it was started with;
- a background task's report: that the task ended and whether it failed, never its summary or its output;
- a hook's refusal: the name of the tool it stopped. Its first line shows only with hookReasons on, because a refusal may quote what the hook found.
week.trDesc: 聊天窗口旁边有一个实时地图，显示 Claude Code 正在做什么：工具调用、模型步骤、钩子、技能和子代理在发生时会亮起。仅限本地使用，提供 7 种语言。
week.trFeat:
- 文件：其路径的最后两部分；
- 网址：仅显示主机，不显示登录名、密码、路径或查询；对于可以两种方式读取的网址，仅显示其方案；
- Shell 命令：Claude 为其撰写的简短描述，或命令的名称，绝不会是命令行。描述是模型自己的话，Mod 会按原文显示； - 记忆调用：工具的名称和记录编号或简短标识符，绝不能是文本或查询；
- 记忆命令：其名称，以及其后的单词（仅当您在 memorySubcommands 中列出了该单词时）；
- 子代理：启动时使用的简短描述；
- 后台任务的报告：任务已结束以及是否失败，绝不会是其摘要或输出；
- 钩子的拒绝：其停止的工具的名称。 其第一行仅在hookReasons开启时显示，因为拒绝可能引用hook找到的内容。

week.desc: AI Manus is a general-purpose AI Agent system that supports running various tools and operations in a sandbox environment.
features: - Autonomous Code Execution: Manus AI agent runs code on its own to complete tasks, so you can focus on decisions instead of repetitive typing and debugging.
- Browser Control Made Simple: Manus browser control lets the agent navigate websites, fill forms, and gather information without you manually clicking through every page.
- Task Automation For Daily Life: Manus autonomous tasks handle small but time-consuming jobs, from organizing research to scheduling reminders, keeping your day running smoothly.
- Personal Assistant That Works Quietly: Manus personal assistant stays ready in the background, responding when you need help with study, home projects, or light work tasks.
- Code And Browser In One Flow: Manus code automation connects scripting with real browser actions, so your workflows move from idea to result without switching between tools.
week.trDesc: AI Manus 是一款通用人工智能代理系统，支持在沙盒环境中运行各种工具和操作。
week.trFeat:
- 自主代码执行：Manus AI 代理自行运行代码来完成任务，因此您可以专注于决策，而无需进行重复的键入和调试。
- 浏览器控制变得简单：Manus 浏览器控制功能让代理能够浏览网站、填写表单和收集信息，而无需您手动点击每个页面。 - 日常生活任务自动化：Manus的自主任务功能可以处理那些琐碎但耗时的事务，从整理研究资料到安排提醒事项，让您的一天井然有序。
- 静默工作的个人助理：Manus个人助理在后台随时待命，当您在学习、家务或轻量级工作任务上需要帮助时，它会及时响应。 - 代码和浏览器一体化：Manus 代码自动化将脚本编写与真实的浏览器操作相结合，让您的工作流程从构思到结果一气呵成，无需在工具之间切换。

Run Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects unchanged on AWS, GCP, Azure or your own servers.
features: - Zero refactoring, zero-downtime migration: your Workers and Durable Objects run as they are, and your data moves off Cloudflare while your app keeps serving.
- The same developer experience: wrangler dev becomes orange dev, and everything underneath is open source and self-hostable.
- Simpler bills: you pay for the machines you run on, not Cloudflare's metering or an enterprise contract. Compute is 4.8× cheaper and storage 8.7× cheaper.
- Built for scale: storage is backed by S3, so scaling out is a matter of adding machines.
week.trDesc: 在AWS、GCP、Azure或您自己的服务器上运行Cloudflare Workers和Durable Objects，无需进行任何更改。
week.trFeat:
- 零重构、零停机迁移：您的Workers和Durable Objects照常运行，您的数据从Cloudflare迁移出去，而您的应用程序继续提供服务。
- 相同的开发者体验：wrangler dev 变为 orange dev，其下所有内容均为开源且可自托管。
- 更简单的账单：您只需为运行所用的机器付费，无需支付 Cloudflare 的计量费用或签订企业合同。计算费用为 4。 计算成本便宜 8 倍，存储成本便宜 8.7 倍。
- 为扩展而生：存储由 S3 提供支持，因此横向扩展只需增加机器即可。
